areas.name: Environmental sustainability, adaptation and mitigation
areas.reason: Strengthens environmental management and climate resilience, including an integrated disaster-risk management system and urbanization of risk areas.

areas.name: Energy efficiency and renewable energy
areas.reason: Housing built with solar water heating, LED lighting, individual metering and water-saving fixtures.

areas.name: Basic sanitation
areas.reason: Integrated urbanization of precarious settlements with water supply, sewage, drainage and waste services, plus sewage treatment for traditional communities.

areas.name: Biodiversity and forest resources
areas.reason: Expansion and structuring of protected areas, including creation of a new reserve tied to an ecological corridor.

areas.name: Infrastructure and social facilities for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: Significant share of actions provides infrastructure for vulnerable populations: urbanization of precarious settlements and resettlement to safe housing.

areas.name: Public-service delivery, management and citizen participation
areas.reason: Social work subcomponent promotes community participation throughout urbanization and resettlement.

areas.name: Education and health conditions
areas.reason: Environmental education and training of multiplier agents to qualify social participation in public policy.

areas.name: Technological development, innovation and modernization
areas.reason: Systems for disaster prevention, environmental enforcement intelligence and territorial information for decision-making.

areas.name: Integrated water-resources management and water security
areas.reason: Effects on water security and soil conservation are indirect impacts, not results of integrated water-resources management actions.

areas.name: Business environment and opportunities
areas.reason: Environmental recovery, urbanization and land regularization help only indirectly, which does not justify points.

areas.name: Individual entrepreneurs and micro/small firms
areas.reason: Information on possible productive arrangements judged insufficient.

areas.name: Jobs and income for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: Land regularization and partnerships said to create conditions for jobs and income; information judged insufficient.

areas.name: Inclusion of social minorities
areas.reason: Benefit to vulnerable families was already credited under 1.9 and community participation under 1.12.

areas.name: Youth, gender and race policies
areas.reason: Proponent only said specific actions would be studied; information insufficient.

areas.name: Financing arrangements encouraging private participation
areas.reason: Proponent only said concessions and public-private partnerships would be studied; information insufficient.
